forefront-church-virginia-beach.assessment: Forefront Church is a contemporary non-denominational congregation in Virginia Beach led by Lead Pastor Jason Bedell. The church has a seeker-friendly posture — 'Everybody's Welcome, Nobody's Perfect, Anything's Possible' — and offers accessibility for those exploring faith. forest-baptist-church-louisville-ky.assessment: Forest Baptist Church is a historic predominantly Black Baptist congregation in Louisville's Newburg neighborhood — tracing back to enslaved congregants who gathered in the forest. Now led by Pastor Nate Bishop Jr. (SBTS graduate), with a strong all-male pastoral team of 5: Bishop (Lead), McGee (preaching/teaching), Tenenbaum (community), Abednego (children/Bible study), McFalls (discipleship). KBC/SBC affiliated — strong denominational accountability. Weekly SOAP Bible studies Tue-Fri show serious devotional investment. Online presence via Facebook, YouTube, and Zoom. Adonis Jackson (Moop's personal friend) serves as deacon. The SBTS training, all-male pastoral staff, and SBC affiliation are strong positives. Remaining yellow items: watch sermons on YouTube to assess preaching depth, confirm complementarian teaching, and verify men's ministry programming.
